name: WOOD, the Hon. Jason Peter

career_spells.role: Police officer; detective, Organised Crime Squad; senior sergeant, Counter Terrorism Coordination Unit
career_spells.evidence_note: Official sources place police service within 1988–2004, detective work in 1990–2000 and senior sergeant work in 2003–2004. These are nested roles, not additive spells. A historical campaign page says he resigned for the 2001 election; reinstatement date and break length are unknown, so this enclosing interval does not assert continuous employment. Full-time status is unverified.

research_notes: Follow up Victoria Police appointment, resignation, reinstatement and leave records, especially the stated 2001 resignation; verify substantive full-time service, precise boundaries, early school-camp employer and all paid work during 2010–2013.

The 1988–2004 interval is an enclosing career range, not 16 countable full-time years. ABC's 13-year description and the 2001 resignation suggest a break requiring documentary resolution. Do not silently reconcile them by inventing dates.

Historical campaign page gives 2006 for a police promotion despite parliamentary service commencing in 2004; this is retained as an unresolved source discrepancy, not adopted as a job boundary. Its attribution and early camp claim need stronger archival corroboration.

Searched official parliamentary and ministerial biographies, Victoria Police employer material, 2013 election reporting, historical campaign biography, public professional-profile results and 2010–2013 employment terms. Namesake results and another ABC candidate's IT consultancy were excluded. No reliable full-time or gap-employment evidence was retrieved.

Potential follow-up: National Library archived campaign site catalogue nla.arc-79223 and original first speech; archive content not yet retrieved. Last follow-up 2026-09-29. Political appointments, party candidacy and community activities do not prove qualifying paid employment.
